Agent Name: Geography_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Geography_Expert made a critical error in the first step by providing incorrect address data for the supermarkets. Specifically, the agent listed "Whole Foods Market" at "1550 N Kingsbury St" and "Costco" at "2746 N Clybourn Ave" as being within the search area, yet the subsequent code execution (which the agent claimed to run) returned distances of ~46 miles and ~45 miles respectively. These addresses are actually located in the Lincoln Park neighborhood but are significantly further than the "2 blocks" constraint (which is roughly 0.1-0.2 miles). The agent failed to verify the actual proximity of these specific addresses to the reference point before including them in the analysis, leading to a false premise that these stores were candidates for the "within 2 blocks" criteria. This initial data error propagated through the entire conversation, causing the subsequent agents to incorrectly conclude that no stores met the criteria, when in reality, the error was in the initial data selection and verification logic.
